{{Quote|Four flaky daggert fillets are dipped in batter, fried golden brown in aola and served on a bed of crunchy sea cabbage with our own secret-recipe Iskalonian tartar sauce.|Dex's Diner menu, on its scalefish fillets|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Iskalonian tartar sauce''' was a type of [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]] and its various [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] collectively known as [[Iskalonian]]s.<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|119|Iskalon}}</ref> The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], claimed to have a secret&ndash;recipe for the Iskalonian tartar sauce it served with the [[scalefish fillets]] and [[Opee sea killer fillet|grilled opee]] it served<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Iskalonian tartar sauce were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
